plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: A perpetual build loop for Claude Code (/fleet:loop: ios, web, api, cli and prototype-only modes) and the workflows it conducts (idea, prototype, build, verify, review, ship, triage), your Fleet's simulators and prototypes, and a quiet session log.

plugins.name: fleet-social
plugins.description: The social side of Fleet without the toolkit: your boat sails in World next to your friends' while you work. Presence only (the project's name, active or idle, an optional local mood score); never prompts, code or logs, no MCP, no skills, nothing in Claude's context. Sign in with /fleet-social:login.
